instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. Use only supplied observations and knowledge. Do not calculate or set emotion.

attributions.cause: The starting squad was strong enough for r1_main_1: it eliminated the enemies and all four player units survived.
alternativeCauses: The weak enemies may have been tuned as an opening fight.
The common loot did not affect this win because equipped power stayed at 0.
attributions.nextTest: Equip or use the new loot if offered, then challenge the newly unlocked r1_main_2 to see whether the same team remains sufficient.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通护手 Lv.4 on 灰鸦战士 directly increased observed equipped power from 0 to 37.
alternativeCauses: No combat or other team change occurred in this action, so the visible effect is limited to equipment power.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_2 with the gloves equipped and see whether the Warrior-led team still wins cleanly.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通靴子 Lv.3 on 灰鸦战士 directly increased observed equipped power from 37 to 66.
alternativeCauses: No battle or roster change happened during this action, so the visible result is the equipment change itself.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_2 with 灰鸦战士 wearing both items and check whether the team clears it without deaths.

attributions.cause: The upgraded starting squad cleared r1_main_2 at observed power 66, eliminating all enemies with all four player units surviving.
alternativeCauses: The r1_main_2 encounter may still be an early low-risk fight.
The Warrior's two equipped items are a plausible contributor, but this action alone does not isolate their effect from the base team.
attributions.nextTest: Review the newly unlocked Mage in the next decision state and decide whether a role swap is worth testing on r1_main_3.

attributions.cause: The selected swap replaced 短矛民兵 with 烬火法师 in slot 2, changing the team composition while leaving equipped power at 66.
alternativeCauses: This action did not test combat strength yet; it only established the new lineup.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_3 with 烬火法师 active and check whether the Mage contributes enough damage to justify the swap.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通头盔 Lv.2 on 拒马民兵 directly increased observed equipped power from 66 to 93.
alternativeCauses: No combat or roster change occurred in this action, so the visible effect is the equipment power increase.
attributions.nextTest: Either equip the remaining boots to an active front unit or challenge r1_main_3 to test the Mage lineup.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通靴子 Lv.2 on 拒马民兵 directly increased observed equipped power from 93 to 120.
alternativeCauses: No combat or roster change happened during this action, so the visible outcome is the equipment increase.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_3 with the Mage lineup and 120 observed equipped power.

attributions.cause: 烬火法师 validated the swap by leading team damage in r1_main_3 and contributing the visible ranged-enemy kill.
alternativeCauses: The geared Warrior and Barricade front line also helped the team survive.
The fight may still be early-region difficulty, so this proves usefulness more than long-term dominance.
attributions.nextTest: Keep 烬火法师 active for r1_main_4 unless new gear or a failure suggests a different composition.

attributions.cause: Replacing 灰鸦战士's Lv.4 gloves with 普通护手 Lv.6 increased observed equipped power from 120 to 131.
alternativeCauses: The old gloves were replaced, so the visible gain is the net upgrade from the stronger item.
attributions.nextTest: Consider the remaining Lv.5 helm, then challenge r1_main_4 to test sustained single-target damage.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通头盔 Lv.5 on 灰鸦战士 directly increased observed equipped power from 131 to 158.
alternativeCauses: No combat or roster change happened during this action, so the visible result is the new helm's power gain.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_4 soon, unless the spare gloves offer a worthwhile active-unit upgrade.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通护手 Lv.4 on 拒马民兵 directly increased observed equipped power from 158 to 195.
alternativeCauses: No combat or roster change occurred, so the visible outcome is the glove equip power gain.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_4 with the fully prepared current team.

attributions.cause: The prepared 195-power team cleared r1_main_4, but the win was fragile because only one player unit survived.
alternativeCauses: The Mage's finishing damage helped secure the clear after several allies died.
The bear fight exposed a survivability concern despite the clear.
attributions.nextTest: Before pushing much farther, consider equipping the new weapon/chest or using the Prison rescue if the next main node looks dangerous.
